summary: Frontend-only testing of new AdminSettings page (/admin/settings) with Arbeitsverträge tab. All acceptance criteria pass: form login as admin@webora.de succeeds, sidebar 'Einstellungen' nav item navigates to /admin/settings without redirect, admin-settings-page renders, tab-contracts + contracts-reader + contract-document present, default ARBEITSVERTRAG doc with '§1 Beginn' visible, switching contract-type buttons updates document content. AT contracts (vollzeit_at, teilzeit_at) contain both 'ÖGK' and 'Kollektivvertrag'; DE contracts (vollzeit, teilzeit, minijob) contain 'Mindestlohn' and 'Sozialversicherung'. New clause header 'Datenschutz, Datensicherheit und ausschließliche Testzwecke' present in all 5 tested contract types. ProtectedRoute verified: after localStorage.clear() navigating to /admin/settings redirects to /admin/login.
context_for_next_testing_agent: AdminSettings page fully working. Login via form (not token injection). Sidebar 'Einstellungen' click routes SPA-style to /admin/settings. All 7 contract types selectable; content verified for 5 (vollzeit, teilzeit, minijob, vollzeit_at, teilzeit_at). ProtectedRoute redirect verified.
